# Locations & Battles

## Academy {#academy}

Located in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) near a quiet neighborhood, the Academy is an educational institution where students are organized into classes to pursue teacher's licenses, compete for medals and scholarships, and engage in their studies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P7](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P8](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P9](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P10](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0010), +28 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue is a four- or five-hundred-yard stretch of road leading to [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge), lined with old apple trees whose canopy creates a snowy, fragrant tunnel of bloom.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P40](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P41](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P42](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0042), [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P43](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0043), +23 more_

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is the hometown of a group of young scholars who left to attend the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P1](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P2](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P3](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P4](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0004), +42 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Bentley](../character/bentley.md), [Elisha Wright](../character/elisha-wright.md), [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md), [Major Spencer](../character/major-spencer.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md), [Uncle Abe](../character/uncle-abe.md)

> During class at the Avonlea schoolhouse, [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious at the insult, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard with a message criticizing her temper, and afterward [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ignores Gilbert's contrite attempt to apologize.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. Beechwood is the residence of Diana's [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) located in town.

## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a picturesque, narrow, and spicy-aired pathway fringed with young birches and wildflowers that winds through Mr. Bell's woods on the route to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a place in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was born, featuring a high school where her parents taught and a small yellow house where her family lived before she became an orphan.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P7](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER V. ## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a noisy, crowded city where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray worked for a winter and Hester Murray worked in a store prior to their marriage, and where [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) returned following her death.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P47](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0047), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P48](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0048), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P49](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0049), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P50](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0050), +8 more_

**Associated with:** [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md)

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location reachable by an eight-mile drive from [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) Cuthbert's home, featuring a train station house with a long platform and ladies' waiting room, as well as a small local hotel.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P12](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0012), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P15](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0015), +26 more_

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrives at Bright River station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, only to discover a young girl waiting for him instead. Unable to bring himself to tell her about the mistake, he decides to bring her home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and let [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) deal with it. As they begin their drive, the girl talks incessantly, expressing her imagination and delight, which [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) finds surprisingly enjoyable.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

## Canadian {#canadian}

Canadian refers to a native-born person from [Canada](../codex/places.md#canada) whose adoption by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) was preferred over a London street Arab because it was felt to carry less risk.

## Carmody {#carmody}

Carmody is a nearby community with a school taught by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), as well as shopping facilities accessed via a road connecting it with [White Sands](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) and [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P53](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0053), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P54](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0054), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P56](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0056), +18 more_

## Crystal Lake {#crystal-lake}

Crystal Lake is a boggy pool named after a suggestion by [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) was drawn from a hat by [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md).

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P23](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0023), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P24](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0024), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P25](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0025), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P26](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0026), +7 more_

## Dryad’s Bubble {#dryad-s-bubble}

the Dryad’s Bubble is a spring located near a log bridge and surrounded by ferns and birch trees, named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P36](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XII. > [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) shares a bedtime story of his good deed with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) before she walks to the Dryad's Bubble to meet [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss the progress and upcoming initiatives of the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) as well as the return of their school teaching friends. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to discuss her busy plan of chores for the following day with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P63](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0063)_

## East Grafton {#east-grafton}

East Grafton is a settlement home to a gravely ill distant relative of [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) named Mary, whose residents did not get along particularly well with her.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P12](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0012), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P13](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0013), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P14](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0014), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P15](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0015), +14 more_

## Echo Lodge {#echo-lodge}

Echo Lodge is a stone house inhabited by Miss Lavendar, which is scheduled to be boarded up and left empty during the winters while being used as a summer home following her marriage.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P73](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0073), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P74](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0074), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P75](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0075), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P76](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0076), +15 more_

> School resumes, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) deal with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and Dora's first days and Mirabel Cotton's ghost stories. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost on their way to a tea party and discover Echo Lodge, where they are invited to stay for tea by the eccentric Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her maid [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md).
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P49](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0049)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) enjoy a charming tea party with Miss Lavendar and her young assistant, Charlotta the Fourth. After showing off her echoes in the garden and explaining Charlotta's name, Miss Lavendar becomes suddenly quiet and worn when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) casually mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). The girls take their leave, promising to visit again soon.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P64](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0064), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P71](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0071), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P81](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0081), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P87](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0087)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss Lavendar at Echo Lodge on a wintry evening, where they share tea, make candy, and discuss Miss Lavendar's past romance with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Miss Lavendar agrees to meet Stephen's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), and a month later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) brings [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to Echo Lodge for a delightful visit.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P9](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0009), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P29](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0029)_

> While berry picking, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) confides in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her worries over Miss Lavendar's melancholy mood and changed behavior. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises to come stay at Echo Lodge during her vacation to help cheer Miss Lavendar up. Later, while having tea in the garden, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) talks with Miss Lavendar about her imaginary dream-boy before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) head home.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P49](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0049), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P51](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0051), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P59](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0059)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Miss Lavendar at Echo Lodge before returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md). Stephen asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to inquire if he may visit Miss Lavendar, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to carry a message and help Miss Lavendar prepare for his arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace

## Green Gables {#green-gables}

Green Gables is the secluded, meticulously kept homestead of [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), situated at the edge of their cleared land in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), reachable by a long, rose-bordered lane, and featuring an orchard-embowered house and a very neat yard.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), +11 more_

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

> Before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) leaves for town with [Dora](../character/dora.md), she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) talk with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about behaving well. Left alone to do chores, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally dyes her nose red with rug dye instead of applying freckle lotion, right as [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md). [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) save the day by bringing chicken for dinner, and the guests enjoy a delightful meal and a walk through the woods before departing.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

> Following [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) proposes that [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into Green Gables so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) can leave to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resigns from her teaching position, which causes great sorrow among her students and her friend [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), even as she prepares for her new journey.

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) becomes sick and dizzy and has to go home, leading Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forbid [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) ever again.

Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits Green Gables, expressing her relief over Matthew's health and admitting to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has matured.

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) apologizes to Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) for looking in her window, and [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) hosts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for tea. [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) agrees to sell her willow-ware platter to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for twenty-five dollars, revealing she is saving money for her upcoming marriage. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) drive home along the Tory Road with the platter, laughing over their adventure.

## Violet Vale {#violet-vale}

Named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Violet Vale is a little green dimple situated beyond [Willowmere](../codex/places.md#willowmere) in the shadow of Mr. Andrew Bell's big woods, famous for having millions of violets in the spring.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P2](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0002), +8 more_

## West Grafton {#west-grafton}

West Grafton is a location accessible via a road that can be reached by walking straight back through the woods from the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) farm.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P8](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0008), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P9](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0009), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P10](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0010), +20 more_

## White Sands Hotel {#white-sands-hotel}

Located along the shore road, the White Sands Hotel is run by Mr. Kirke and serves as a summer resort popular with American visitors.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P22](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P23](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P24](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0024), +18 more_

**Associated with:** [Timothy Cotton](../character/timothy-cotton.md)

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for her recital at the White Sands Hotel, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to offer her own proud yet gruff commentary. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) rides to the hotel with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), and [Billy](../character/billy.md), where she experiences severe stage fright before performing. After catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds her courage, gives an outstanding performance that earns an encore, and enjoys the post-concert reception.
>

## Willowmere {#willowmere}

Willowmere is a location passed by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on their romantic walk to the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school after traversing Mr. Barry's back field.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P70](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0070), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P0](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
